mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( SEQ INT IDENTITY (1,1) NOT NULL, AGENT_ID VARCHAR(50), WATCHDOG_STATUS VARCHAR(10), WATCHDOG_INTERVAL INT, THREAD_LLT VARCHAR(1000), UPDATE_DATE DATETIME, ETC VARCHAR(256) )
mapper.select: SELECT AGENT_ID AS agent_id, WATCHDOG_STATUS AS watchdog_status, WATCHDOG_INTERVAL AS watchdog_interval, THREAD_LLT AS thread_loop_time, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(19),UPDATE_DATE,120),'-',''),' ',''),':','') AS update_date, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(19),GETDATE(),120),'-',''),' ',''),':','') AS db_date FROM ${tableName} WHERE WATCHDOG_STATUS = #{watchdogStatus} ORDER BY AGENT_ID

SELECT AGENT_ID AS agent_id, WATCHDOG_STATUS AS watchdog_status, WATCHDOG_INTERVAL AS watchdog_interval, THREAD_LLT AS thread_loop_time, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(19),UPDATE_DATE,120),'-',''),' ',''),':','') AS update_date, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(19),GETDATE(),120),'-',''),' ',''),':','') AS db_date FROM ${tableName} ORDER BY AGENT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( AGENT_ID, WATCHDOG_STATUS, WATCHDOG_INTERVAL, UPDATE_DATE, ETC ) VALUES ( #{agentId}, #{watchdogStatus}, #{watchdogInterval}, GETDATE(), #{monotonicTimestamp} )
